article.title: Eating in Bangalore
article.excerpt: Many of you useful MR reader recommendations here . I’ll recommend the Muslim food stalls along Cock Burn avenue, especially during Ramadan. First-rate for haleem is Hotel Fanoos (the attached restaurant) in Richmondtown, near the Hosur Water Tank. The Chinese restaurant in the Oberoi is not to be missed. For South Indian food, try Athityam in Jayanagar
